figurative_meaning_en: Pure water obtained through laborious straining
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অর্জিত জ্ঞান ছাঁকা জলের মতো বিশুদ্ধ।
এই সাফল্য ছাঁকা জলের মতো কষ্টের ফল।
example_sentences_in_english: His acquired knowledge is as pure as strained water.
This success is like strained water, the result of hard work.
history: Originating from traditional rural practices of straining impure water through cloth to obtain purity, symbolizing refinement through effort in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom highlights the cultural value of perseverance in achieving clarity and purity in Bengali society.
